description_en: Retrieves the deployment status and related information of a specified traffic control task in a specific environment
description_zh: 获取指定流量调控任务在特定环境下的部署状态和相关信息
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice query-traffic-control-task-deploy-result --traffic-control-task-id 1 --instance-id pairec_1230000 --environment Daily --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryTrafficControlTaskDeployResult

parameters.help_en:
The environment. Valid values:
Daily: daily environment.
Pre: staging environment.
Prod: production environment
parameters.help_zh: 所属的环境。Daily-日常环境Pre-预发环境Prod-生产环境
parameters.name: environment

DeployMessage.description_en: The message returned for the Flink platform deployment operation
DeployMessage.description_zh: flink 平台部署操作的信息

DeployStatus.description_en:
The status of deploying the draft. Valid values:
Failed: failed.
Running: running.
Success: succeeded
DeployStatus.description_zh:
部署草稿的状态，枚举值：
`Failed`：失败。
`Running`：运行中。
`Success`：成功

DraftMessage.description_en: The message returned for pushing the draft to Flink

DraftStatus.description_en:
The status of pushing the draft to Flink. Valid values:
Failed: failed.
Running: running.
Success: succeeded
DraftStatus.description_zh:
推送草稿至Flink的状态，枚举值：
`Failed`：失败。
`Running`：运行中
`Success`：成功

PrepareMessage.description_en: The message returned for the preparation phase

PrepareStatus.description_en:
The status of the preparation phase. Valid values:
Failed: failed.
Running: running.
Success: succeeded
PrepareStatus.description_zh:
准备阶段的状态：
`Failed`：失败。
`Running`：运行中
`Success`：成功

StartMessage.description_en: The message returned for starting the Flink task

StartStatus.description_en:
The status of starting the Flink task. Valid values:
Failed: failed.
Running: running.
Success: succeeded
StartStatus.description_zh:
启动Flink任务状态，枚举值：
`Failed`：失败。
`Running`：运行中。
`Success`：成功

v1_parameters.help_en:
The environment. Valid values:
Daily: daily environment.
Pre: staging environment.
Prod: production environment
v1_parameters.help_zh: 所属的环境。Daily-日常环境Pre-预发环境Prod-生产环境
v1_parameters.name: Environment
